title: PageRelationshipDescriptor
description: Describes a reverse relationship shown on an entity page: records of a source entity whose foreign key points back to the host page record.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: a foreign key on the source entity defines the schema direction; a page relationship defines how related records are shown from the host (target) page. `sourceEntityName`/`sourcePropertyName` identify the FK property that points at the page entity. Use `access: "view"` for read-only related lists and `access: "edit"` for CRUD. Use `generated` modes to let the runtime build the related page/forms from the source entity, `page`/`form` modes to reuse named descriptors, and `inherit` to reuse the related page's own create/edit forms. Set `useSeparatePermission: true` when child access must not inherit the host page permissions.

id.description: Stable identifier unique within the page, for example 'customer-orders'. Used by relationship permissions and runtime routes.

sourceEntityName.description: Full name of the entity that owns the foreign key pointing at this page's entity.

sourcePropertyName.description: Foreign key property on sourceEntityName that references the page entity.

access.description: Access level from the host page: 'view' shows related records read-only; 'edit' allows create, update, and delete.

relatedPageMode.description: How the related list is rendered. 'generated' builds a list from the source entity; 'page' reuses the page named by relatedPageName.

relatedPageName.description: Existing page name for the source entity. Required when relatedPageMode is 'page'.

createFormMode.description: Form used to create related records. 'generated' builds a form from the source entity; 'inherit' reuses the related page's create form; 'form' uses createFormName.

createFormName.description: Form descriptor name for the source entity. Required when createFormMode is 'form'.

editFormMode.description: Form used to edit related records. 'generated' builds a form from the source entity; 'inherit' reuses the related page's edit form; 'form' uses editFormName.

editFormName.description: Form descriptor name for the source entity. Required when editFormMode is 'form'.

useSeparatePermission.description: When true, relationship view/create/update/delete permissions are resolved for the host page and relationship id instead of inheriting the host page decision.

permissionConfig.description: Optional relationship permission overrides used when useSeparatePermission is true.
